title: lazyfish plan
description: The output of the design phase for one ticket. Keys are English and fixed; prose values may be written in whatever language the team designs in.

ticket.description: Tracker key of the ticket this plan is for, e.g. PROJ-123.

understanding.description: What the ticket asks for, restated in the plan author's own words.

changes.description: Files the implementation is expected to touch.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root.

reason.description: Why this file has to change.

confidence.description: How sure the plan is about this particular change.

assumptions.description: Statements taken as true without verification. Must not be empty: a plan with no stated assumptions is hiding them, not free of them.

alternatives_considered.description: Approaches that were rejected, and why.

open_questions.description: Anything still undecided. If a question is genuinely settled, record it with blocking=false and the answer in the text rather than dropping it.

blocking.description: True when work cannot responsibly start until this is answered.

acceptance_criteria.description: Observable outcomes. Each one must be checkable by running something or looking at something, not by judgement.

risks.description: Optional. Ways this plan could go wrong, with mitigations.

confidence.description: Overall confidence in the plan as a whole.

needs_human.description: True when a person must review before implementation starts. Must be true when confidence is low or any open question remains.
